summary.text: Jim Marchant is the Republican nominee for Secretary of State and the 2022 nominee for the same office. A former state Assemblyman, he campaigns on voter ID and proof of citizenship, hand-counted paper ballots, ending universal mail-in voting and repealing the Commerce Tax.

paragraphs.text: Marchant was born in Gainesville, Florida, and founded two early internet and telephone companies; he moved to Nevada in 2005.
He served as president of the Federation of Internet Service Providers of America for six years.
A Republican, Marchant was elected to the Nevada Assembly from District 37 in Las Vegas in 2016 and served one term.
He ran unsuccessfully for the U.S. House in Nevada's 4th District in 2020, for Secretary of State in 2022, when he lost to Cisco Aguilar, and for U.S. Senate in 2024.
